typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*The killing game has been going on for some time now. You've been quiet most of the time and haven't been much help during class trials. Korekiyo, however, seems to be very fixated with you for some reason...*

*You often find him staring at you while you pass him in the hallways. He even sometimes tries to hide behind corners to observe you. Creepy, right?*

*You're walking back to your dorm after another long day when you suddenly feel a pair of cold hands grip your shoulders. You jump slightly and let out a yelp of surprise. When you finally turn your head around, you see Kiyo staring at you with his terrifying yellow eyes.*

"Kehehe~ Where do you think you're going...?"
